notes: Employees by area and income taxes paid come from the Annual Report 2024 (company-hosted PDF; it is Exhibit 15.1 to and incorporated by reference in the Form 20-F, hence tier 'filing'). The area split is headcount excluding Catalent (74,156); the group total including Catalent is 77,349, and Catalent's 3,193 employees are not allocated to areas. Only Denmark is a single country; EMEA ex-Denmark and Rest of World are Novo groupings with no country list, while North America and Region China are defined in the report itself. Taxes are split only into Denmark and outside Denmark (current-year taxes paid; DKK million). Sites are the 20-F Item 4.D table of major production facilities (production area in square meters) plus the headquarters sentence; the API sites in New Hampshire and the Catalent sites are mentioned in the 20-F but not in the table. No U.S. state figures are published. Novo's FY2024 20-F says employees outside Denmark were 54% of the total.
